In addition to repurchases under our repurchase program, we will pay a cash dividend for the third quarter of 2026 of $0.50 per share of Class A Common Stock payable on November 19, 2026, to eligible holders of record at the close of business on November 12, 2026.
We expect to continue paying quarterly cash dividends in respect of our Class A Common Stock and OpCo Units.

The McElroy Ranch asset brings concentrated mineral ownership in an expected core fairway of emerging Barnett development, while the Pending Buckhorn Acquisition adds high-quality Midland Basin inventory with approximately 80% overlap with our existing footprint.

Notably, we funded, or expect to fund, these acquisitions primarily with cash, delivering on the commitment we made when we revised our return of capital framework to pursue accretive M&A with minimal reliance on equity.
These acquisitions add years of visible development to Viper’s portfolio and reinforce the durability of our long-term per-share growth outlook.”
